title: Detection of Freshwater Pearl Mussel Using qPCR
author: Omneya Osman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.974h9qw
materials: Qiagen DNeasy power water sterivex kit

The concentration of freshwater pearl mussel standard was measured by PicoGreen assay ( http://tools.thermofisher.com/content/sfs/manuals/PicoGreen-dsDNA-protocol.pdf ) before preparing standard serial dilutions. Serial dilutions, 10, 1, 0.1, 0.01 and 0.001 ng, were prepared to generate standard curve in each qPCR run. Unio pictorum or Äkta målarmussla was used to test the specificity of qPCR detection.

QPCR was performed in BioRad qPCR machine CFX96. Analysis of the results was done by CFX maestro software https://www.bio-rad.com/en-se/product/cfx-maestro-software-for-cfx-real-time-pcr-instruments?ID=OKZP7E15 QPCR efficiency, limit of detection and quantification range of standard were checked for each run. Results can be evaluated through data analysis windows where there is a quantification, standard melt curve and RFU spreadsheet.

DNA extraction was performed using Qiagen DNeasy power water sterivex kit. The quality of the extracted DNA was estimated using Nanodrop. Qiagen DNeasy power water sterivex protocol can be found in this link: https://www.qiagen.com/se/resources/resourcedetail?id=c5fe7d5f-070a-4ebe-ac04-4bbf05a13e91&lang=en

steps.title: Prepare qPCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a master mix calculated based on the number of standard dilutions, samples, and negative controls. The final composition per 20 µl sample is as follows:

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µl of SsoAdvanced Universal SYBR® Green Supermix 2x (final conc 1x).
Add 0.5 µl of MarMa_16SF primer (10 µM working sol, final conc 0.25 µM).
Add 0.5 µl of MarMa_16SR primer (10 µM working sol, final conc 0.25 µM).

steps.title: Seal qPCR Plate
steps.instruction: Carefully seal the sample or qPCR plate, ensuring there are no markings on the tubes to facilitate the plate reader step.

steps.title: Run qPCR Program
